description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mukkama, Katana D/S Division Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511200
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
